svg.text: A relationWith B compares A.start/A.end against B.start/B.end; overlapWith excludes only NoRelation, After, StartTouching, EndTouching, and Before.
Read every row with A fixed
Blue bar is the receiver period A. Orange bar is the argument period B. Names are the enum returned by source code.

g.text: same start, B ends inside A
A and B have identical bounds
B contains A or cuts into A
same start, B extends after A
B starts before A, same end
